issues.title: [Epic · Week 3] Synthetic vertical slice and credible product prototype
issues.outcome: Deliver a coherent end-to-end product flow using representative synthetic data so the project can be demonstrated without Arcaea content.
scope: Capture prototype evidence for the later lowiro request.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary journey works in production build.
Every record is synthetic and clearly labeled.
Page states, provenance UI, and missing media are demonstrated.
The prototype is credible enough to explain intended publication scope.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Epic · Week 3] Synthetic core pages and related-entity flow
issues.outcome: Deliver reusable home, explore, song, and collection templates using synthetic content.
scope: Own shared templates, related navigation, provenance blocks, and media-free states.
acceptanceCriteria: Home → explore → detail flow works.
Unknown/review/synthetic status is visible.
Missing data degrades gracefully.
No route depends on runtime or real game data.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 3 · Feature] Synthetic homepage, discovery entry, and project introduction
issues.outcome: Create a polished landing page that demonstrates product value with synthetic highlights and an explicit pre-authorization notice.
scope: Project introduction, synthetic catalog highlights, search entry, catalog status, preview limitations, legal status, and complete route states.
acceptanceCriteria: All highlights come from synthetic versioned data.
Primary actions are visible early.
No real game news or asset is implied.
Keyboard and screen-reader flow is tested.
Preview status cannot be mistaken for a released Arcaea catalog.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 3 · Feature] Synthetic explore search, sort, filters, and shareable URL state
issues.outcome: Demonstrate fast, deterministic catalog discovery using representative synthetic records.
scope: Search, filters, sorting, result count, URL state, reset, no-results, invalid-query, stale-index, keyboard, and responsive behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Refresh/share preserves state.
Filtering and stable sort are tested.
Synthetic labels remain visible where needed.
Representative dataset meets the agreed budget without premature services.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 3 · Feature] Synthetic song and collection detail templates
issues.outcome: Build production-quality detail templates using invented songs, difficulties, collections, relationships, sources, and placeholders.
scope: Identity, factual layout, difficulty comparison, source/review block, relationships, missing/unknown states, and metadata hooks.
Use generic `collection` terminology internally where possible; map approved domain terminology later.
acceptanceCriteria: Every displayed value has source/status behavior.
Related navigation is bidirectional.
Only approved synthetic placeholders are used.
No AFF, playback, analytics, real Arcaea record, or official image appears.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.
